title: Mossy Forest Palette
summary: Eight named hex/RGB swatches for wet stone, bark and undergrowth under cool overcast light, with contrast checks and pairing notes for ground, foliage and UI.

title: Ruined Tower on a Hill
summary: 512x384 painted key art: a broken stone tower silhouetted on a hill under an indigo-to-amber dusk sky; strong single focal point with open space on the left third for titles or UI.

title: Health Potion Icon
summary: 32x32 flat-vector red potion flask with a tan cork and a 1px dark outline; stays readable at 16px on light or dark HUD bars, with no slot frame or badge baked in.

title: Mossy Stone Tile
summary: Seamless 64x64 top-down cobblestone with cold grey-green stones, dark mortar and moss in the joints; low internal contrast keeps repeated tiles clean at 1x, so it fits overgrown ruins and forest floors.

title: UI Confirm Blip
summary: 0.22 s mono two-tone confirmation blip (880 Hz to 1320 Hz) with a soft attack and a click-free cosine fade; about -4 dBFS peak, 22050 Hz 16-bit PCM.
